resources.string: Turns a PDF into a BOOX notebook whose pages are the PDF\'s own shape, with the PDF\'s links working.
Pages match this screen\'s shape and will fill it.
Pages are narrower than this screen; they will fill the height.
Pages are wider than this screen; they will fill the width.
Saved %1$s (%2$s) in Download/Papermill. Open it in Notes to import it; copy the file to use it on another BOOX device.

That PDF has a page layout Papermill can\'t use.
The BOOX Notes app isn\'t available here. Copy the file from Download/Papermill to a BOOX device and open it there.
